notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm.
description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Gigantoplasm's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Gigantoplasm leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
